title: Forward Deployed Engineer

location.name: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States

content: <div class="content-intro"><p>Example Robotics builds picking robots for mid-size warehouses. Forward Deployed Engineers sit with customers and turn a pilot into a working system.</p></div><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Write Python and TypeScript services that connect our fleet to each customer&#39;s warehouse software through their APIs</li><li>Build RAG and LLM features for the operator console, with evals that run before every release</li><li>Prototype on site, then hand a stable version to the core team</li><li>Own a small AWS footprint per customer and the SQL that reports on it</li></ul><p>The base salary range for this role is $165,000 &#8211; $210,000.</p><p>Example Robotics is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants without regard to protected veteran or military status.</p>
